Imports (step 1), execution state (step 2), the 3-entry load effect with non-401 execution errors mapped to undefined and 401 rethrown (step 3), and the LifecycleStepper render with deriveStage(round.status, execution?.status) (step 4) are all in place. I did not write deriveStage: it already exists at HEAD 64f5550 (UNIT-121), so no step was adapted. Blocker: after I started, another actor staged a removal of deriveStage and EXECUTION_STAGES from LifecycleStepper.tsx in the index, and added untracked tests/deriveStage.test.ts. In the worktree as it stands, tsc fails (TS2305 on deriveStage in AdminApp.tsx and in the deriveStage test) and 14 tests fail, including 4 AdminApp tests. I left the index and that file alone. Verification in a scratch copy with HEAD's LifecycleStepper.tsx and my AdminApp.tsx: tests/admin.test.tsx and tests/deriveStage.test.ts pass, 16/16, and no tsc errors in AdminApp, LifecycleStepper or api/client. The scratch tsc run had unrelated path errors from the copy missing sibling @game directories. The Atlas unit markdown for UNIT-122 is not present under .ai-dlc/units (only UNIT-001 to UNIT-010), so I worked from the brief alone. Needs: whoever staged the deriveStage removal to restore it or confirm it is intended; then re-run tsc and vitest in the worktree.
